name: disable_object_script_events

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableObjectScriptEvents takes no Script context, clears D_003854E0.unk_3070 bit 59, and does not access the value stack

notes: Bit 59 gates the object script-event dispatchers func_001C6068 and func_001C6620; clearing it prevents those dispatch paths. The only JP call occurs on cinematic entry after object control is disabled. Inverse command 423 restores the gate during cinematic cleanup.
